verdict.rationale: Otter documents several first-party background automations: the notetaker can be scheduled to auto-join all meetings, briefing documents are delivered before meetings, and meeting outputs are pushed automatically to the CRM, Airtable, Zendesk and ServiceNow. A community report that the bot kept joining calls on its own corroborates that it runs autonomously. These are fixed, predefined behaviors, though, not user-authored automation workflows with their own triggers and conditions; custom logic needs Zapier or the API. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/rule builder with custom triggers, conditions and recurring schedules, docs on configuring and monitoring these background runs, and independent hands-on confirmation of the integration automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Schedule your AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all your Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings.
Have briefing documents delivered before your meeting with all the prior discussions, action items, and updates you need.
Key deal details, notes, and next steps automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to your CRM.
Automatically turn meeting takeaways into support tickets or updates in tools like Zendesk and ServiceNow.
Otter automatically sends transcripts, summaries, and meeting metadata to Airtable.
Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
